constraint: The user requires presentation itself (including the GUI) to be recovered from the original, not re-implemented as a self-made window. Early WinForms/GDI/WASD/HUD prototypes are explicitly not recovered work per the project document.
consequence: A self-built WinForms/GDI host must NOT be presented as a human-testable reverse-engineered client. It would be exactly the "original-looking substitute" the project forbids.

present.camera math contracts: CameraTargetContracts, WorldCameraImageContracts, SystemUcrtRotationMath (recovered, with frozen receipts)
present.UI export enumeration: docs/reverse-client/r1-ui-api-engine-exports, r1-ui-api-game-exports, r1-setui-exe-* (export tables and call sites)

absent.D3D11 device and swapchain: only 8 files in the whole repo mention d3d11/dxgi/Present, and none recovers the device or present loop
absent.camera -\u003e screen projection loop: input math exists, the render-time projection and viewport publication do not
absent.UI drawing and text: export tables exist, the draw path and font handling do not

why_this_matters: Without the present path there is no frame to look at, so no human test is possible; and a self-made frame would invalidate the reverse-engineering claim.
next_reversal_sequence: Locate the engine device/swapchain creation (Engine.dll) and record the exact call sequence with Rea, as was done for the camera and navigation paths.
Recover window creation and message pump ownership, so the recovered host can own its own window rather than borrowing a test harness.
Recover the per-frame present call and the viewport/camera publication that feeds it.
Recover the UI draw path (at minimum text and simple quads) for the parts R1 needs.
Only then assemble a host that renders "recovered" frames; until then, no human-testable build exists.
not_done: No self-made GUI was built and none will be presented as recovered.
